column1: # boru Language Specification: the boru:vault module (host-vault bridge words)
# Loadable module bridging boru to the host's secret vault
# (design/VAULT-TUI-PORT.0.md §3). The words are reached only after
# The spec harness registers NO vault backend (there is no vault on CI),
# so every reachable word pins the first-class no_backend error, and the
# usage contract is pinned BEFORE the backend lookup — malformed
# arguments raise vault_usage headlessly. Live happy paths run in Go
# against a scripted fake (lang/go/modules/vault_test.go), exactly how
# module-tui.tsv leaves live terminals to Go.
# §3  no backend registered → the first-class no_backend error, across
#     the word groups (reads, reveal, mutation, settings, multi-vault,
